description: This file contains a Kotlin class PermissionHelper that manages runtime permission requests for Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi Direct functionalities within an Android application. It handles permission requests based on different Android API levels and provides public methods to initiate permission prompts with callback handling.

classes.name: PermissionHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing runtime permissions related to Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi Direct features in an Android app. It abstracts permission requests for different Android API levels and handles user responses via callbacks.

methods.name: PermissionHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PermissionHelper with an ActivityResultCaller for registering the permission request launcher.

methods.name: requestBluetoothPermissions
methods.description: Requests the necessary Bluetooth permissions depending on Android version, and invokes callback with true if permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestWifiDirectPermissions
methods.description: Requests the necessary Wi‑Fi Direct permissions based on Android version, and invokes callback with true if permissions are granted.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Internal method that checks for missing permissions, requests them if needed, and executes the callback with the result.
